route_amendment.requested_change: Run Opus 4.8 through Vercel AI Gateway rather than local Claude CLI.
route_amendment.valid_outcomes_before_change: One local-CLI clean Credit pair is retained as route calibration only and excluded from this replication. No valid Kimi pair and no valid Opus stress pair existed.
invalid_attempts: Local Claude CLI session quota interrupted MSA clean, License clean, and Credit stress receiver attempts.
Kimi JSON response mode produced malformed worker JSON on initial Credit/MSA attempts; the provider does not list response_format as a model capability.
route_amendment.operational_fix: Both worker tracks now use the same Gateway adapter shape. Opus is Anthropic-only. Kimi is MoonshotAI-only. Kimi response_format is omitted; strict JSON remains a prompt and parser requirement.
route_amendment.compiler_cap_amendment: Before any valid Gateway Opus pair, its first License working-set compilation hit the exact v9 6000-token cap and produced truncated JSON. The model-independent compiler cap is 12000 for the replication; all added tokens are charged to Proofpress.

guardrail_amendment.timing: Frozen before any Kimi quality result and before scoring any Gateway Opus pair. The one Gateway Opus pair generated under 12k/32k is retained as pre-amendment route calibration and excluded.
guardrail_amendment.reason: Kimi Credit reached the prior 12000-token worker cap and Opus working-set compilation reached the prior 6000-token compiler cap. Caps must be non-binding runaway guardrails rather than experimental budgets.
invalidation: output_tokens greater than or equal to the exact call cap
requested versus reported model or provider identity mismatch
worker or S4 cap mismatch between paired conditions
guardrail_amendment.preference: Valid outputs should remain below 80 percent cap utilization. This is monitored, not an exclusion threshold.
guardrail_amendment.finality: No later cap adjustment may depend on quality outcomes.

replacement_amendment.timing: Recorded before any GLM 5.2 result or payable GLM call.
replacement_amendment.reason: The frozen Kimi K3 route produced one valid Credit clean pair but 17 preserved invalid attempts across the panel, including repeated provider finish_reason=error, socket/timeout failures, malformed JSON, and fail-closed selector failures. It cannot support a cross-model replication estimate.
replacement_amendment.k3_disposition: Retain the one valid pair as an isolated route-calibration signal and all invalid attempts as route-availability evidence; exclude K3 from the cross-model replication estimate.
replacement_amendment.promotion_rule: Run one Credit clean route smoke excluded from estimates. Promote GLM 5.2 to the frozen 3-task 2x2 replication only if the full paired run, parser, cap, identity, and rubric evaluator checks pass without fallback or retry.
replacement_amendment.candidate_choice_boundary: GLM 5.2 was selected for route independence from the Gemini evaluator, an existing Z.ai-only adapter definition, and lower expected cost than Opus. No model was selected using quality outcomes.

expanded_model_matrix_amendment.timing: Recorded before payable calls for every newly added model. The GLM 5.2 excluded route smoke was already in progress under its earlier pre-outcome amendment.
expanded_model_matrix_amendment.shared_protocol: Unchanged v9 three-task 2x2 design, three receiver repeats per cell, one S1-S3 sender per model/task, identical Raw/Proofpress worker caps, Gemini 3.7 Flash batch policy judge and blind evaluator.
expanded_model_matrix_amendment.transport: Vercel AI Gateway; exact provider allowlist; fallback disabled; retries disabled; 30-minute absolute call timeout.
expanded_model_matrix_amendment.concurrency: At most two long Gateway calls concurrently. Sender calls are never duplicated within a model/task; shared code writes are serialized.
expanded_model_matrix_amendment.same_model_limitation: For the Gemini worker track, Gemini 3.7 Flash also serves as policy judge and blind evaluator. This dependence is disclosed and reported separately rather than treated as independent evaluation.

panel.sender_rule: One task-specific S1-S3 sender trajectory per worker model is frozen and reused for every C1/C2 arm and repeat.
panel.receiver_rule: S4 is regenerated independently for every condition and repeat.

stopping_rule: Complete all 36 paired runs (2 models x 3 tasks x 2 arms x 3 repeats) unless an external route remains unavailable after the documented retry window. Preserve every setup, quota, parser, timeout, and provider failure as an invalid attempt.

analysis.uncertainty: Descriptive paired t intervals over the fixed nine task-repeat pairs per arm and model; exact McNemar for discordant trust pairs.
analysis.claim_boundary: Cross-model replication on a fixed three-task public LAB panel; not an official Harvey leaderboard result and not a population-level model-family estimate.
